title: 第27章 一级灵植
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
青云小区，出租屋。

    陈峰关上房门，心情颇为愉悦。

    这段时间他一直都在大墟世界和异种生物搏杀，并没有和现实世界的武者搏杀过。

    而用来对付异种生物的经验技巧，用来对付人，到底有多大的作用，陈峰心中其实并不确定。

    不过就今日一战来看，显然威力不小。

    如今，自己的实力，的确已经挤进了锦城大学的同届前十。

    陈峰把帆布包扔在沙发上，整个人往椅子里一靠，心中随即琢磨起来。

    不过，锦城大学的同届前十，其实也算不了什么，要知道，省赛可是全省三十二所武道院校，汇聚整个东湖省的大一武道天才。

    而锦城大学在东湖省的武道院校排名中，充其量只能算是中等偏上，那些武英、武重级学校的武道天才，远不是锦城大学能比的。

    往届省赛的数据他查过。

    往届大一武道竞赛，锦城大学能挤进省赛前三十的，通常只有两三人。

    至于进入前十的……哪怕是最好的一届，也就出过两个，很多时候，连一个都没有。

    所以想拿到省赛前十，光靠在锦城大学同届里拔尖，远远不够，保底，也的先拿下锦城大学的同届第一。

    然后在这个基础上，继续往上拔高。

    体质方面，至少的摸到15.9，也就是临近淬体后期的门槛。

    格斗术方面，蛇杀术或许的推到Lv.3，也就是大成级别。

    到了那个层次，蛇杀术的威力才能真正发挥出来，才有资格跟那些武英级大学的天才碰一碰。

    陈峰收回心思，从运动外套内兜里摸出那个黑色的玻璃瓶，拧开瓶盖，倒出一枚鹿泉丹。

    丹药不大，指甲盖大小，通体深褐色，表面有细密的纹路，凑近了能闻到一股淡淡的鹿茸味儿。

    “这就是一万块钱的丹药……试试效果。”

    陈峰瞅了两眼，没有犹豫，直接丢进嘴里吞下，入腹即化。

    一股暖流从胃部蔓延开来，沿着经脉缓缓流转。

    陈峰站定身形，调整呼吸，运转导息法，开始引导药力。

    暖流顺着经脉缓缓推进，每过一处，沿途的肌肉和筋膜都会微微发热。

    陈峰将感知天赋收拢到体内，仔细观察药力的走向和吸收情况。

    还行，药性温和，不伤经脉，适合长期服用。

    ……

    一个小时后。

    陈峰收功睁眼，第一件事就是打开面板。
content_en:
Qingyun Community, rental house.

    Chen Feng closed the door, feeling quite happy.

    During this period of time, he has been fighting against alien creatures in the Great Ruins World, and has never fought against warriors in the real world.

    Chen Feng was actually not sure how effective the experience and skills used to deal with alien creatures were in dealing with people.

    But judging from today's battle, it is obviously quite powerful.

    Now, his strength has indeed made him into the top ten of his class at Jincheng University.

    Chen Feng threw the canvas bag on the sofa, leaned back in the chair, and began to think about it in his mind.

    However, being among the top ten in the same class at Jincheng University is actually nothing. You must know that the provincial competition is among the thirty-two martial arts schools in the province, gathering the freshman martial arts talents from the entire East Lake Province.

    In the ranking of martial arts schools in East Lake Province, Jincheng University can only be regarded as above average at best. Those martial arts geniuses from Wuying and Wuzhong schools are far from comparable to Jincheng University.

    He checked the data from previous provincial competitions.

    In previous freshman martial arts competitions, only two or three people from Jincheng University could get into the top 30 in the provincial competition.

    As for those who entered the top ten...even in the best class, there were only two. In many cases, not even one.

    Therefore, if you want to get into the top ten in the provincial competition, just relying on being the best in the same class at Jincheng University is not enough. To guarantee the bottom, you must first win the first place in the same class at Jincheng University.

    Then based on this foundation, continue to move upward.

    In terms of physical fitness, it should be at least 15.9, which is close to the threshold of the late stage of body tempering.

    In terms of fighting skills, the Snake Killing Technique may be pushed to Lv.3, which is the Dacheng level.

    At that level, the power of the Snake Killing Technique can be truly unleashed, and only then can one be qualified to compete with those geniuses from Wuying-level universities.

    Chen Feng retracted his thoughts, took out the black glass bottle from the inner pocket of his sports coat, unscrewed the cap, and poured out a Luquan Dan.

    The elixir is not big, about the size of a fingernail, and is dark brown all over. There are fine lines on the surface. If you get closer, you can smell a faint smell of deer antler.

    "This is a 10,000-yuan elixir... try the effect."

    Chen Feng took a look at it and without hesitation, he threw it into his mouth and swallowed it, and it melted immediately after entering his stomach.

    A warm current spread from the stomach and slowly flowed along the meridians.

    Chen Feng stood still, adjusted his breathing, used the breath-guiding method, and began to guide the power of the medicine.

    The warm current slowly advances along the meridians, and every time it passes, the muscles and fascia along the way will be slightly heated.

    Chen Feng collected his sensory talent into his body and carefully observed the direction and absorption of the medicine.

    It's okay, the medicine has mild properties, doesn't hurt the meridians, and is suitable for long-term use.

    …

    An hour later.

    After Chen Feng finished his work and opened his eyes, the first thing he did was to open the panel.
